other_conditions: Postgraduate degree with at least 55% marks is required
Priority is given to candidates enrolled in central or state government universities in Rajasthan
A maximum of two children from a single family can apply

Applicant must have secured admission to a Ph.D. program in a recognized university in Rajasthan in one of the specified subjects (Sociology, Public Administration, Law, Economics, Political Science, Anthropology)
Applicant must submit a certificate of admission from the Head of the concerned University or Institute
Applicant must submit a certificate of attendance as prescribed by the University Grants Commission (UGC)
An annual progress report of the research work must be submitted to the department
benefits_summary: Recipients receive a monthly fellowship of ₹15,000 for up to three years, directly transferred to their bank account.
documents_required: Certificate of admission from the Head of the concerned University or Institute
Certificate of attendance as prescribed by the University Grants Commission (UGC)
Undertaking on a non‑judicial stamp of ₹100
